english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for attempting something, experimenting with an action, or trying something out.
Use this for putting something to the test or trying it out.

examples.english: I haven’t tried making this dish before, so I’ll try it today.
examples.traditional: 我未試過整呢味餸，今日試吓先。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mei6 si3 gwo3 zing2 ni1 mei2 sung3 gam1 jat6 si3 haa5 sin1

examples.english: Try this new pen; it may prove easy to use.
examples.traditional: 你試吓呢支新筆，可能幾順手。
examples.jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 ni1 zi1 san1 bat1 ho2 nang4 gei2 seon6 sau2
